title: GameMaker
summary: Notes for using Game Arts files in GameMaker. Written from the manual pages read on 2026-10-24; nothing was run in the IDE, so every mapping is documented and none is observed. Only what those pages state is mapped.

import_guidance.text: A sprite has one speed. If frames in an animation need different times, repeat the longer frames or set the speed to suit the shortest and repeat the others.
Set the sprite's Origin from the atlas pivot; the default is the top left corner.
Use the runtime copies the framework derives (real transparency instead of the magenta background) when importing images.

concept_map.engine_term: the sprite's Origin x and y
concept_map.note: Default top left; typed values may be negative to put the origin outside the sprite. Set it from the atlas pivot (the cell pivot minus the picture's offset in its cell).

concept_map.engine_term: one animation speed per sprite, in frames per second or frames per game frame
concept_map.note: The sprite page describes no time for each frame.

concept_map.engine_term: the sprite editor's Nine Slice section, with a guide offset for each edge
concept_map.note: Not available for non-bitmap sprites. The page does not state an order for the four margins: enter each on its own edge.

concept_map.engine_term: the 47-tile auto tile template of the tile set editor
concept_map.note: You click each template cell and pick the tile for it, so the tile for every arrangement is chosen by hand. The template's own cell order was not read here.
